description: This file defines the ObjectUtils class, providing static utility methods for handling JSON objects such as checking for boolean or string entries, creating JSON objects with boolean values, serializing boolean values, and adding entries to JSON objects.

classes.name: ObjectUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for manipulating JSON objects related to boolean and string entries.

methods.name: bool HasBooleanEntry(const JsonObject & obj,const string & key,bool & resultValue)
methods.description: Checks if the given JSON object has a label with the specified key and if the associated value is a boolean. If so, stores the boolean value in resultValue and returns true; otherwise, returns false.

methods.name: string CreateBooleanJsonString(const string & key,const bool value)
methods.description: Creates a JSON object with a boolean key-value pair and serializes it to a string.

methods.name: JsonObject CreateBooleanObject(const string & key,const bool value)
methods.description: Creates and returns a JsonObject with a single boolean entry for the given key.

methods.name: void AddBooleanEntry(JsonObject & obj,const string & key,const bool value)
methods.description: Adds a boolean key-value pair to the provided JsonObject.

methods.name: bool HasStringEntry(const JsonObject & obj,const string & key,string & resultValue)
methods.description: Checks if the JSON object has a label with the specified key and if the associated value is a string. If so, stores the string value in resultValue and returns true; otherwise, returns false.

methods.name: string BoolToJsonString(const bool value)
methods.description: Serializes a boolean value to a string: "true" or "false".
